notes.title: Try the New Test Build Today!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Playtest of [b]Moon 2999[/b] – Join the Lunar Adventure![/h1]

We’re opening the gates to an [b]exclusive Playtest[/b] of [b]Moon 2999[/b]!
Your participation is [b]crucial[/b] to help us polish the game before its official release.

[h2]Why join?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Get early access to the world of [b]Moon 2999[/b]
[*]Build and manage your lunar base in the year 2999
[*]Explore space and take on missions solo or in co-op
[*]Battle rival factions for control of resources
[*]Share your feedback and directly influence development
[/list]

[h2]How can you help?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play the Playtest and explore all available features
[*]Report bugs, balancing issues, or ideas via the dedicated forum
[*]Share your thoughts on gameplay, visuals, and UI
[/list]

Every comment, suggestion, or bug report helps us make [b]Moon 2999[/b] even better.

[b]📅 Available now – Join the adventure and leave your mark on history![/b]

notes.title: Update #826
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/1665476d92538af26a60f79e4a539aa48e26f6c4.png[/img]  
Hello,  
We are thrilled to present the latest improvements and major additions to the game, designed to enrich your experience and enhance player interactions.  
Here’s an overview of the new features now available:  

[b]Corporation:[/b]  
Create and Manage a Corporation (Guild): You can now establish your own corporation, recruit members, and collaborate to achieve common goals.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/31c55d52238273bd206516f3a495bc6a552db505.png[/img]  
Co-op Mode with Leaderboard (Contribution): A brand-new way to play and cooperate with other players!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/d40af5f9e1bb01fe7d67118845236f8de7e88fe6.png[/img]  
Fight Bosses with Rankings  

[b]Space Port Contracts:[/b]  
Discover an exciting new economic feature with the Space Port.  
You can accept inter-corporation contracts, assign your units to complete them, and earn valuable resources while fulfilling your commitments.  
The more contracts you complete, the higher your reputation will grow.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035949/d055a6d5b5cab16672854f00ce03085536c4dd93.png[/img]  

These additions aim to strengthen the community and strategic aspects of the game.  

An "open" test version is available on the Android Playstore. Feel free to try it and share your feedback/bugs!  
The Steam version is progressing well and should be ready for testing at the beginning of Q1.  

Thank you for your support!
